# Schema ids already published by Jellyfin 10.11.5 and a reference set of community plugins (listed below).
# A type of ours whose schema id is listed here breaks GET /api-docs/openapi.json for the whole server.
# Read by kit/testsupport/Api/SchemaPrefixChecks.cs.
#
# Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the OpenAPI document of a sandbox with Jellyfin 10.11.5, Bookmarks 1.0 and the newest copy
# of each of those community plugins, minus Bookmarks 1.0's own 8 ids: 409 ids, 357 from core and 52 from the community
# plugins. Refresh it after a Jellyfin or community-plugin update: list the schema ids of GET /api-docs/openapi.json in
# a sandbox with the same plugins, then remove our own plugins' ids.
